description: How much credit support or guarantee exposure will NVIDIA have signed for AI cloud partners under its new revenue-sharing and credit-support model by 2027-12-31?
outcome: The amount of signed credit-support, guarantee, or similar credit-enhancement commitments NVIDIA discloses for AI cloud partners under the new model.
period: 2027-12-31 (check date within 18 months of the 2026-07-01 item, for an unsigned obligation)

description: How much equity will NVIDIA hold in Intel, and at what total committed amount, at NVIDIA's next annual report, following its $5 billion equity investment in Intel?
outcome: The size and carrying amount of NVIDIA's equity stake in Intel, and any additional commitment, disclosed at NVIDIA's next annual report.
period: NVIDIA's next annual report (FY2027 Form 10-K, expected early 2027); the investment is already undertaken, so it is tracked by its amount at the next annual report.

description: Will NVIDIA's Vera Rubin AI chip platform begin shipping by the end of calendar 2026?
outcome: First shipments of Vera Rubin to customers, confirmed by NVIDIA.
period: 2026-12-31 (the item says shipping could begin later in 2026, from a 2026-07-02 article)

description: Will China's government permit NVIDIA to sell its H200 AI chips to Chinese customers, lifting its current block, by NVIDIA's fiscal year-end 2027-01-31?
outcome: A Chinese government/regulator decision allowing H200 sales in China, evidenced by an official Chinese decision or by NVIDIA-confirmed H200 shipments/revenue to Chinese customers.
period: 2027-01-31 (NVIDIA's current fiscal year-end; set because the item reports a pending regulatory decision with no date of its own)

description: Will the U.S. Commerce Department conclude its investigation into whether DeepSeek accessed restricted Nvidia AI chips and announce penalties or new export-control measures by NVIDIA's fiscal year-end 2027-01-31?
outcome: A U.S. Commerce Department/Bureau of Industry and Security finding, penalty, or new export-control measure stemming from the investigation into DeepSeek's access to restricted Nvidia chips.
period: 2027-01-31 (NVIDIA's current fiscal year-end; set because the item reports a pending regulatory investigation with no date of its own)

description: How much will the big four AI hyperscalers spend in combined data center capital expenditures in calendar 2026?
outcome: The sum of calendar-2026 data center capex actually reported by the big four AI hyperscalers, versus the roughly $650 billion they are reported to plan for this year.
period: Calendar 2026; settled by the four hyperscalers' full-year 2026 capex disclosures in their Q4 2026 earnings reports (January–February 2027), the release date of the quantity.

description: Will NVIDIA's Vera Rubin Ultra / Kyber NVL144 rack-scale system begin shipping to customers by the end of calendar 2028, following SemiAnalysis's report that its debut slipped from 2027 to 2028 (which NVIDIA disputes, saying its roadmap is intact)?
outcome: First customer shipments of the Kyber rack-scale architecture (NVL144) with Vera Rubin Ultra, confirmed by NVIDIA.
period: 2028-12-31 (the item says the Kyber debut was pushed to 2028 from a 2027 plan; the check date is the end of that year. If NVIDIA's 'roadmap is intact,' shipping in 2027 would also settle the by-end-2028 question affirmatively.)

description: How much will the big four AI hyperscalers spend in combined data center capital expenditures in calendar 2027, versus NVIDIA management's forecast that hyperscaler spending will top $1 trillion?
outcome: The sum of calendar-2027 data center capex actually reported by the big four AI hyperscalers, compared with the over-$1-trillion figure NVIDIA management forecast for 2027.
period: Calendar 2027; settled by the four hyperscalers' full-year 2027 capex disclosures in their Q4 2027 earnings reports (January–February 2028), the release date of the quantity.

description: How much will NVIDIA have outstanding in supply/purchase commitments at its next annual report?
outcome: The dollar amount of NVIDIA's supply commitments (purchase and capacity commitments) disclosed in its FY2027 Form 10-K, versus the $119 billion cited in this item.
period: NVIDIA's next annual report (FY2027 Form 10-K, expected early 2027); the commitments are already undertaken, so they are tracked by their amount at the next annual report.

description: What share of Chinese companies' AI accelerator spending will go to domestic suppliers over the 12 months following July 2026, versus the 46% planned in the Bloomberg Intelligence survey?
outcome: The realized share of Chinese enterprises' AI accelerator budget captured by domestic suppliers (Huawei, Hygon, Cambricon and others) over the 12 months from mid-2026, measured against the 46% planned and the 30% current level.
period: The 12 months from the survey's release on 2026-07-07 (to mid-2027); settled when follow-up survey or market-share data covering that period are published.

description: How much will NVIDIA have invested in Firmus Technologies, and what equity stake will it hold, following its reported ~$500 million ($721 million) subscription to Firmus' $2.9 billion equity raising, once Firmus lists on the ASX?
outcome: The amount NVIDIA invests and the equity stake it holds in Firmus Technologies after its preference shares convert to ordinary equity at Firmus' ASX IPO.
period: Firmus' ASX listing later in 2026 (preference shares convert to ordinary equity there); the stake is already undertaken, so it is also tracked by its amount at NVIDIA's next annual report (FY2027 Form 10-K, expected early 2027). Set from the item's 'later this year' listing timing, within 18 months of the 2026-07-08 item.

description: What will the spot rental price of an hour of Nvidia H100 GPU compute average over calendar 2026, after peaking around $3.20/hour in May 2026 and then declining?
outcome: The realized spot rental price for an hour of H100 GPU time over calendar 2026, versus the ~$3.20/hour May 2026 peak.
period: Calendar 2026 (check date 2026-12-31); set from the item's reported May-2026 peak (~$3.20/hour) and subsequent decline in the H100 spot-rate series.

description: What will happen to HBM/DRAM contract prices over the 12 months to mid-2027, after rising roughly tenfold over the past year and becoming the data-center bottleneck?
outcome: The change in HBM/DRAM contract prices over the 12 months to mid-2027, versus the roughly tenfold rise over the prior year.
period: The 12 months to 2027-06-30 (next calendar year); set from the item's report that memory prices rose tenfold over the past year and its view that conditions will persist absent an HBM breakthrough.

description: Will France's competition authority conclude its antitrust investigation into Nvidia's cloud-AI and GPU markets and issue a decision (fines or remedies) by Nvidia's fiscal year-end 2027-01-31?
outcome: A final decision by the French competition authority on its antitrust probe into Nvidia's cloud-AI and GPU practices.
period: 2027-01-31 (Nvidia's current fiscal year-end; set because the item reports a pending regulatory decision 'nearing a conclusion' with no date of its own)

description: How much will U.S. federal agencies obligate in AI-related spending in calendar/fiscal 2026, and how much in new AI-related contract awards will be recorded?
outcome: The total AI-related spending obligated by U.S. federal agencies in 2026 (reported at $7.2 billion so far, versus $675 million in 2024) and the value of potential AI contract awards (reported at $91.8 billion, versus $4.6 billion in 2024).
period: Calendar/fiscal 2026; settled by year-end 2026 U.S. federal procurement data (e.g., USAspending.gov) reporting total AI-related obligations and contract awards. Set from the item's 2026 obligations figure ($7.2 billion) and potential-awards figure ($91.8 billion).
